Reading fields with the Graph API

Request only the fields you need with the fields parameter:

GET /me?fields={id,name,email}

Every request needs your key. In the examples below, replace the placeholder with your own:

https://api.example.com/v1/items?api_key=YOUR_API_KEY&limit=10

Searching

To search the public index, use the web_search API endpoint with a q parameter. Results are paged; pass cursor for the next page.

Errors

A 401 means the key is missing or revoked. A 429 means you are over your rate limit; retry with backoff.
